Federal Register 
V o l. 49, N o. 61 
Wednesday, March 28, 1984
Presidential Documents
11799
The President
Executive Order 12469 o f M arch 26, 1984
East-West Foreign Trade Report
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the statutes 
o f the United S tates of Am erica, including section 301 o f Title 3 o f the United 
States Code (3 U.S.C. 301), and section 411(c) of the Trade A ct of 1974 (19 
U .S.C. 2441(c)), in order to provide for more efficient reporting to the Congress, 
it is hereby ordered as follow s:

clauses.label: Section 1.
clauses.text: Section 1. The reporting functions o f the E ast-W est Foreign Trade Board under

clauses.label: section 411
clauses.text:
section 411(c) of the Trade A ct of 1974 (19 U.S.C. 2441(c)), as transferred to the 
President by section 5(c) o f Reorganization Plan No. 3 of 1979 (19 U.S.C. 2171 
note), are delegated to the United States Trade Representative.

clauses.label: Sec. 2.
clauses.text:
Sec. 2. This order is effective upon publication in the Federal Register.
TH E W H ITE HOUSE, 
M arch 26, 1984.[FR D oc. 84-8486 
Filed 3-20-84; 4:30 pm] 
Billing co d e  3195-01-M
